caveats: Whole-cohort pose includes all46/49; coordinate diagnostics are44/46 CAL and42/49 TEST after a fixed model/reference phase compatibility check
GT poses and hidden corner targets are historical annotation reconstructions, not independent physical measurements
Raw and final coordinate comparisons use the exact same finite original raw corners; initial-rigid and old-progressive comparisons use exact matching frame/native slots
DIRECT_OUTLINE/MODEL_INTERIOR categories use the initial geometric outline, not certified actual background contact
UNANNOTATED coordinates are separate diagnostics and are not evidence of semantic hidden/visible correction
Human truncation and fully-hidden labels absent from this eligible-coordinate cohort; no performance conclusion for those categories
Completion versus raw includes the benefit already present in initial rigid projection; it is not solely new refinement contribution
Nominal covariance ellipse coverage is an exploratory failure diagnostic, not a claim of calibration
No variant or threshold is selected from these TEST/state/coverage outcomes
Single-recording categories cannot estimate between-recording uncertainty; their degenerate bootstrap quantiles are not labelled as an informative95%CI.

scientific_assessment.evidence_supports: Some independent RGB boundary measurements improve same-corner localization; explicit anchor-protection/DOF/provenance contracts are implemented. PoseFix+Sub transfer improves own initial success39to42 in reusedTEST49.
scientific_assessment.evidence_does_not_support: Uniform hidden-coordinate improvement beyond initial rigid geometry, superiority over older N3 progressive correction, calibrated uncertainty or unseen generalization.
scientific_assessment.failure_explanation: Image-derived anchor measurements improve more than the final rigid projections. Optimizing visible-point/prior proxy with fixed-seed anchor budgets does not bound unobserved GT projection errors. Initial-state mistakes, virtual/rounded corner mismatch and low-count internal evidence can propagate through rigid completion; these are interpretation of contracts and observed patterns, not a per-frame causal certification.
scientific_assessment.false_negative_initial_self_visibility: Human SELF_OCCLUDED used points:CAL2/TEST_N3_2/TEST_PF_4; actual invariant is initial-predicted-H exclusion, not oracle-human-hidden exclusion.
scientific_assessment.supplementation_limits: RGB junction final fit used only CAL2frames/TEST_N3_0/TEST_PF_1; raw-to-junction coordinate effects are mixed. No consistent causal hidden-correction contribution established.
scientific_assessment.uncertainty_limits: Nominal95ellipse coverage only60.16%/67.5%/63.13% on accepted model-compatible corners; surrogate assumptions and omitted bias are exposed, no calibration claim.
scientific_assessment.reporting_required: Keep all whole-pose failures, fixed coordinate-phase exclusions and single-session external category. Separate raw→initial rigid benefit from initial→new refinement. Retain stronger older/ablation outcomes and never select a variant from TEST.
scientific_assessment.supplementation_stage_explanation: TEST_N3 observed RGB junctions either fail fixed-seed anchor budgets or lack adequate support; none survives final fit. PF additionally has a measured bootstrap later vetoed by immutable full-pool validation. This is a deliberate evidence-protection/limited-observability tradeoff, not absence of image measurements.
